title: A Mimir
description: A configurable mod to apply buffs (1 or more!) after waking up! fun in SMPs!
body:
# 😴 A Mimir

Sleep with benefits.

Tired of yelling at your friends to get in bed? A Mimir is a lightweight, server-side mod that makes sleeping **rewarding**.

When a player sleeps, the sleeper wakes up **_refreshed_** with configurable buffs to start their day.

### ⚡ "Morning Coffee" Buffs

Skipping the night isn't just convenient; it's empowering. Players who sleep are granted configurable status effects upon waking up to get them ready for the grind.

_Default Buffs_: Absorption & Strength (Fully customizable!).

_Customizable Duration_: Control how long the morning rush lasts. (defaults to 60s)

### 📢 Chat & Titles

Let the server know who saved them from the phantoms.

_Action Bar / Title Support_: Displays a wake-up message to the sleeper.

_Global Chat Announcement_: "The night was skipped by [Player] and is [CAFFEINATED]!"

_Randomized Tags_: The chat message randomly picks a high-energy tag like [WIRED], [LOCKED IN], or [OVERCLOCKED].

![mod preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39a13811dde6bfdf57e891d64ecbe9013085d756_0.webp)

## ⚙️ Configuration

The config file (_amimir_config.json_) lets you tweak almost everything:

**isSleepFeatureEnabled**: Toggle the entire mod.

**isSoundEffectsEnabled**: Toggle the waking up SFX.

**effectsDuration_Seconds**: Fine-tune specific buff timers in seconds.

**wakeUpMessage**: The text displayed in the action bar (top of your hotbar).

**skipperBuffs**: A list of effects to apply (e.g., MobEffects.SPEED, MobEffects.REGENERATION).

    MobEffects.ABSORPTION
    MobEffects.BLINDNESS
    MobEffects.FIRE_RESISTANCE
    MobEffects.GLOWING
    MobEffects.HASTE
    MobEffects.HEALTH_BOOST
    MobEffects.HUNGER
    MobEffects.INSTANT_DAMAGE
    MobEffects.INSTANT_HEALTH
    MobEffects.INVISIBILITY
    MobEffects.JUMP_BOOST
    MobEffects.LEVITATION
    MobEffects.LUCK
    MobEffects.MINING_FATIGUE
    MobEffects.NAUSEA
    MobEffects.NIGHT_VISION
    MobEffects.POISON
    MobEffects.REGENERATION
    MobEffects.RESISTANCE
    MobEffects.SATURATION
    MobEffects.SLOWNESS
    MobEffects.SPEED
    MobEffects.STRENGTH
    MobEffects.UNLUCK
    MobEffects.WATER_BREATHING
    MobEffects.WEAKNESS
    MobEffects.WITHER

**wakeUpTags**: You can add more here!

## 📥 Installation

Download the .jar file.

Install the Fabric API.

Drop both into your server's /mods folder.

Restart the server and go _A Mimir_ 😴🥀

#
_You can put this mod on your modpacks! A shout out will do 😉_
